about.p1: I'm a passionate traveler with over 50 countries visited and counting 🌍✈️
about.p2: With commercial experience in web development, I am now fully focused on frontend technologies, creating fast and accessible user interfaces.
about.p3: 🎓 I have no formal education in IT — but I've gained my knowledge through self-study, online courses, and practical experience. I believe that passion and curiosity matter more than a diploma.
about.cats: Outside of work, I'm a proud owner of two cats 🐱🐱

journey.title: Path to IT
journey.subtitle: My story in IT started as an accident that became destiny. In 2020, during the pandemic, I discovered web development. Since then, I've gone from freelancing to working with Bitrix and eventually found my way to frontend. Now I'm learning modern frontend technologies and writing React. 🎓 I don't have a formal IT degree. My knowledge comes from self-study, courses, and practice. I believe that a true developer is not defined by a diploma — but by curiosity and a passion for creation.
